title: Garlic Butter Brown Sugar Pork Chop
description: A flavorful pork chop cooked with garlic, brown sugar, and butter, finished in the oven for a tender and delicious meal.

ingredients.item: Pork chops (bone-in or boneless, as preferred)

steps: Heat a cast iron pan with oil over high heat. Sear the pork chops on both sides until browned, then set aside.
In the same pan, add butter and reduce heat to low. Stir in brown sugar and minced garlic. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Return the pork chops to the pan. Spoon the melted butter mixture over the chops.
Transfer the pan to an oven preheated to 400°F (200°C). Bake for about 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and transfer pork chops to a cutting board. Let rest for a few minutes, stirring the sauce occasionally.
Optional: Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
